entities.name: Zagras
entities.description: An infamous vampire rogue from Zendikar, right-hand to the Kalastria bloodchief Drana.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: A Kalastria bloodchief who promised Zagras the first gifts of creation.

entities.name: Skyclaves
entities.description: Dangerous structures on Zendikar that Zagras scours for the means to create new bloodchiefs.

events.summary: Zagras devotes himself to scouring the Skyclaves for the means to create new bloodchiefs, promised the first gifts by Drana.
events.quote: Drana has promised Zagras that should he find the secret of creation, he will be the first to receive its gifts.

relations.note: Zagras is her right-hand and unquestioningly loyal.
relations.quote: Zagras is right-hand to the Kalastria bloodchief Drana
